mapper.insert: INSERT INTO offsite_notification_inbox(event_id, event_type, recipient_id, order_id, reference, fingerprint) VALUES (#{event.eventId}, #{event.type}, #{event.recipientId}, #{event.orderId}, #{event.reference}, #{fingerprint}) ON CONFLICT (event_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT fingerprint FROM offsite_notification_inbox WHERE event_id=#{eventId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO offsite_notification_deliveries(request_id, event_id, channel, recipient, subject, message, status) VALUES (#{command.requestId}, #{eventId}, #{command.channel}, #{command.recipient}, #{command.subject}, #{command.message}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT request_id, channel, recipient, event_id AS reference, subject, message, attempts, provider_id FROM offsite_notification_deliveries WHERE status IN ('PENDING','RETRY','ACCEPTED') AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ORDER BY next_attempt_at, request_id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE offsite_notification_deliveries SET attempts=attempts+1, lease=#{lease}, next_attempt_at=statement_timestamp() + INTERVAL '30' SECOND WHERE request_id=#{requestId} AND attempts=#{attempts} AND status IN ('PENDING','RETRY','ACCEPTED') AND next_attempt_at <= statement_timestamp()
